Anecdotes about Nana Patekar shared by acquaintances

Anecdotes about actor Nana Patekar have been shared by individuals who knew him. Aneet Padda became emotional recalling her time working with Patekar, stating it was special and she learned a lot from him. Pakistani cricketer Tanvir Ahmed spoke about a 32-year friendship with Patekar, mentioning that Patekar called him every week. News18 Hindi reported on Patekar's past relationship with an actress, for whom he played an onscreen father, and his inability to cope with their breakup.
